request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
When does my residence permit expire, and what should I do before then?

response.text:
## Your residence permit

Your current residence permit expires **30 Nov 2026** [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf], as shown in the immigration office's letter [doc:doc_d9hwr1mp3bsj].

**What to do before then:**

- **Attend the appointment** at the Ausländerbehörde (Stadt Musterstadt) on **14 Oct 2026 at 10:30** [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp] to file your extension application. Bring your original passport, current enrolment certificate, proof of financial means, proof of health insurance, a biometric photo, and your rental agreement/landlord confirmation.
- **Pay the application fee** of 100.00 € on-site at the appointment [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m] — by girocard only, cash is not accepted.
- If you can't make the appointment, there's a to-do reminding you to cancel it with the office in good time [item:itm_5frk207bsfq1].
- Filing the extension application before the permit expires means, per § 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG, that your stay is deemed to continue until the office decides [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf].

**One thing to check:** your passport also needs attention — it's flagged as expiring soon [item:itm_g321eme013j2], and the record notes a residence permit usually can't run longer than the passport's validity, so make sure your passport will still be valid well beyond the permit extension.

This isn't legal advice — if anything about the extension process is unclear, it may be worth asking the Ausländerbehörde or an advisor directly.

Sehr geehrter Herr Rivera,

Ihre Aufenthaltserlaubnis zum Zweck des Studiums nach § 16b Abs. 1 des Aufenthaltsgesetzes
